Use the full Muse Spark 1.3 token budget as the skeptical validation lane. Independently characterize the current M5 grip deficit before proposing code. Design or extend deterministic tests that measure: steady-state lateral g, front/rear slip angle at moderate steering, yaw response, force-vs-slip curve shape, outside/inside tire load and mu, trail-braking retention, power-on lateral retention, and post-peak recovery. Identify which measurable failure best explains 'tires made of rock / no grip'. Prefer instrumentation/tests over tuning. If an implementation change is clearly implied, propose the smallest patch and list exact regression commands including test:tire, test:cornering, test:m5-transient, test:conventions, and test:m5-validation:strict.
